question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><munderover><mo>∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></munderover><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><munderover><mo>∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></munderover><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to (where <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to <math><mi>x</mi></math>)

solution.text:
I1=∫0π2esin⁡x+xesin⁡x.cos⁡xdx=xesin⁡xπ20=πe2
I2=∫0π2ecos⁡x+x-ecos⁡x.sin⁡xdx=xecos⁡xπ20=π2
Hence, I1I2=e⇒e=2
